thread:
maria: quick follow-up to the offload companion idea. I sketched a minimal allocator hint surface to reduce fragmentation during staged offload. goal: opt-in, low-overhead, metrics-first.
liam: paste the sketch? want to see how it interacts with soft_reserve and leases.
maria: sure. idea: provide an optional AllocHints at alloc time with a companion_tag, frag_tolerance, prefer_host_backing flag, and soft_reserve_bytes. runtime interns the tag -> tag_id stored at slab granularity.
devon: slab-granularity tagging makes sense to avoid per-block bloat. storing tag_id in slab header is cheap.
sam: +1, intern IDs so hot path sees integer compares only. avoid string ops.
anya: fallback for callers without tags: default "__untagged" and optional fingerprinting during experiments. production defaults to no-fingerprint to keep behavior deterministic.
liam: good. rollout: canary clusters, 48-72h metrics window, auto-disable per-tenant if p50 token latency regresses >5%.
maria: telemetry we need: companion.* host_staging_bytes, vram_bytes, fragmentation_ratio, evictions_per_min. can we add dashboards?
anya: will add dashboards and alerts. created obs ticket.
devon: policy questions: prefer within-tag compaction initially; cross-tag compaction only during low load or if fragmentation > threshold.
sam: eviction ranking should consider frag_tolerance so we evict from tolerant companions first.
liam: also add config to allow merging tags (map multiple logical tags to one bucket) for ops experiments.
maria: action items: open RFC PR with API sketch, devon to prototype intern table, sam to add fast-path intern, anya to dashboard, liam to author SLO auto-disable rule.
infra-bot: noted: canary flag will be `allocator.companion_tags.enable`. coordinate runtime and deploy teams for rollout.
